worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.summary: Crouch low, then drive the fist up a vertical arc in front: every foe caught is lifted clean off the ground and falls back down, and a target already off the ground when hit takes a harsher blow. The only move of the family that sends a foe skyward.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.use.0: Uppercut a point-blank foe into the air
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.use.1: Chase down an airborne or jumping foe and hit it harder
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.use.2: Lift a foe off its position to set up the next beat
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.descriptio: Sweeps a %3$s-degree vertical arc %2$s blocks long in front and upward; every enemy caught takes one hit for about %1$s contact and punch damage.
Every target hit is lifted off the ground with an upward speed of %1$s blocks/tick and sent %2$s blocks along the aim; the arc reaches %3$s blocks overhead.
The airborne bonus applies only to a target already off the ground when hit: its damage is multiplied by %1$s; a grounded target gets none.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.rising.on: Skyward: launch speed %1$s lifts foes higher, at the cost of %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.rising.off: Driving: power rises to %2$s with a faster start, but the launch speed is only %1$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.timing: Range %1$s blocks; start %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.growth.0: From level %1$s the uppercut power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.growth.1: From level %1$s the uppercut power rises to %2$s and the launch speed to %3$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.skyuppercut.preference: On (skyward): x1.35 launch speed lifts foes higher to set up the next beat, at the cost of x0.88 power, +1 start, +1 recovery and +5 cooldown. Off (driving): x1.12 power with a faster recovery and cooldown, more like a heavy close uppercut, and launch speed only x0.75.
